caption:
About 20 by 60 inches of deck for running, especially for tall runners; about 20 by 55 is fine for walking. Compare continuous duty horsepower, not peak. Claude and GPT choose the same product: Sole F80.
Type 1billionmodels.com/treadmills for every pick and check. https://1billionmodels.com/sports-and-outdoors/sports-and-fitness/exercise-and-fitness-equipment/cardio-training/treadmills?src=youtube&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer
